records.assetReview: The 10×10×10 cm cube has volume 1 L and front 40×40 px at 4 px/cm. It lies fully below surface y235: top y280, bottom y320. Three separate force paths share 4 px/N: tension 20 N has length 80 px upward; buoyancy 10 N has length 40 px upward; weight 30 N has length 120 px downward. Stacked bars 80 + 40 = 120 px equal the separate 120 px weight bar. Complete XML, independent marker paths and full native rendering read.
records.distractors: 30 N is true weight,10 N buoyancy;40 N adds opposite supports incorrectly. Mass is unchanged by immersion.
records.manualArithmetic: Weight is 3 kg×10 m/s²=30 N; buoyancy is 1 kg/L×1 L×10=10 N upward. Equilibrium T+10−30=0 gives T=20 N.
records.physicalAssumptions: Rigid closed impermeable body completely immersed in static homogeneous water rho = 1 kg/L, g = 10 m/s², suspended by an ideal vertical string from above. No contact, capillary, air or string-volume effects. Domain V>0,m>rho V implies 0<T<mg. The gravitational mass and weight remain unchanged; tension is not the resultant.
